scope: 登录、邀请码注册、账户显示与退出入口

ui.visual_language: meal photography, plum/mint palette, editorial split layout, no AI-style dashboard cards

browser_smoke.server: temporary production server on port 3194 with migrated database copy
browser_smoke.bootstrap_invite: server-only test bootstrap; value omitted from evidence
browser_smoke.registration: browser selected 邀请码注册, submitted a new account, and reached /dashboard
browser_smoke.account_menu: authenticated username rendered in the account menu
browser_smoke.logout: browser opened the personal menu, selected 退出登录, and returned to /access
browser_smoke.relogin: same account logged in again and reached /dashboard

http_smoke.cookie: ft_session is HttpOnly and session state is not exposed to the UI

implementation: src/app/access/page.tsx now owns login and invite registration states and calls /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register
src/components/sidebar.tsx loads the current public session identity and exposes logout
src/components/app-chrome.tsx hides authenticated navigation for /auth and /access
src/app/auth/page.tsx provides the public route alias expected by the auth gate
